query: The company's goal is to select a subset of 110 potential investment projects that willmaximize the total expected Net Present Value (NPV).The optimization must satisfy the budget limit and the following strategic dependencies: (1)Budget Constraint:Total capital investment cannot exceed 1,000 k$; (2)Mutually Exclusive Constraint (Projects 4 & 7):Selectat most oneof Project 4 (R&D Initiative Alpha) or Project 7 (Global Expansion Pilot); (3)Pre-requisite Constraint (Project 6 requires 1):Project 6 (System Automation) can only be selected if Project 1(Infrastructure Upgrade) is also selected; (4)Contingent Constraint (Project 10 requires 5):Project 10 (Customer Experience Platform) canonly be selected if Project 5(Staff Trainig Program) is also selected. All required data is provided in project.csv.
